title: Seamless: Multilingual Expressive and Streaming Speech Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating translation robustness and overgeneralization using the Multilingual HolisticBias dataset by comparing performance metrics (chrF, ASR-chrF, BLASER 2.0) between masculine and feminine translations, as well as testing for grammatical gender translation errors via red teaming.
Red teaming evaluation assessing whether the model produces more translation errors when prompted with varying input pitch ranges.
Red teaming evaluation assessing whether the model produces more translation errors when prompted with varying speaker accents.
